title: Retire geometry dependencies safely
scope: Define and implement replace/remove/reset lifetime for geometry referenced by live bodies.
acceptance: Tests cover referenced mesh replacement, removal, stale generations and unrelated-body preservation.
Pending work and recorded references follow documented lifetime rules.
